name: OpenClaw Observability
description: OpenTelemetry-based observability for OpenClaw with semantic conventions for AI agents (Ant Spec v2.0)

enableTelemetry.label: Enable Telemetry (Master Switch)
enableTelemetry.help: Must be enabled for any telemetry data collection. Env: AGENT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1

debug.label: Debug Logging
debug.help: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. Does not enable transcript capture or offline replay. Env: OBSERV_OPENCLAW_DEBUG

dynamicUsername.label: Dynamic Username
dynamicUsername.help: Read ant.username from AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME whenever telemetry is recorded

dynamicUid.label: Dynamic UID
dynamicUid.help: Read ant.uid from AIVISION_ANT_UID whenever telemetry is recorded

otelExporter.label: OTel Exporter Configuration
otelExporter.help: Base OTLP endpoint, protocol, and headers. Can also be set via OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* env vars.

logDir.label: Plugin Log Directory
logDir.help: Directory for the plugin-owned observ-openclaw.log file. Defaults to the OpenClaw runtime logs directory for common edition or ~/.aivision/ocw/logs for AIVision. Env: AIVISION_LOG_DIR or OBSERV_OPENCLAW_LOG_DIR

enableTelemetry.description: Enable telemetry collection (master switch). Env: AGENT_ENABLE_TELEMETRY

collectionMode.description: Content collection mode. full records raw content; privacy redacts content. Env: AIVISION_COLLECTION_MODE

debug.description: Enable verbose plugin diagnostic logging. Env: OBSERV_OPENCLAW_DEBUG

dynamicUsername.description: Resolve ant.username from AIVISION_ANT_USERNAME whenever a span, event/log, or metric is recorded

dynamicUid.description: Resolve ant.uid from AIVISION_ANT_UID whenever a span, event/log, or metric is recorded

endpoint.description: Base OTLP endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT

attributes.description: Common span/event/metric attributes, including ant.username and ant.uid. Env: OBSERV_OPENCLAW_OTEL_ATTRIBUTES

resourceAttributes.description: Resource attribute overrides, including ant.agent.* metadata. Env: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, AIVISION_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, OBSERV_OPENCLAW_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES. ant.uid is signal-only; agentic.collection.mode is forced from collectionMode.

endpoint.description: OTLP traces endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT
OTLP metrics endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT
OTLP logs endpoint URL. Env: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_ENDPOINT

metricExportInterval.description: Metrics export interval in milliseconds. Env: OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL

logsExportInterval.description: Logs/Events export interval in milliseconds. Env: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORT_INTERVAL

businessAppId.description: [DEPRECATED] No longer used. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.

businessScene.description: [DEPRECATED] No longer used. Kept for backward compatibility with existing configs.

logDir.description: Directory for the plugin-owned observ-openclaw.log file. Priority: this value, AIVISION_LOG_DIR/OBSERV_OPENCLAW_LOG_DIR, then the edition default.

ingestConfig.description: Path to the private AI Vision ingest configuration
